task_meta.title: Make a wide orders table work on mobile

judge.reasons: Phone uses tidy cards (order #, total, status badge, customer, date; labelled secondary details) plus sort chips and full-width controls. Desktop is a clean 9-column table. Screenshots can't show empty or loading states.

claim_text:
The Orders page now works on a 390px phone with no sideways scrolling, and desktop is still a normal table. I tested it in headless Chrome only, not on a real phone or in Safari or Firefox. In that browser:
- **No sideways scrolling** at 320, 390, 600, 820, 821, 900, 1024 or 1440
digest: Read 10 files (3 before its first edit), made 3 edits, ran tests 9 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
